question: Which of the following cities is situated on the banks of river Saryu ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ayodhya.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Sarayu** is a river that originates at Nanda Kot mountain in Uttarakhand,
 
• The Sarayu river is mentioned various times in the ancient Indian epic of Ramayana.
 
• Sarayu is also the name of the river that flows by the fictional town of Malgudi created by R. K. Narayan.
 
• **Sarayu river fl**ows through the city of Ayodhya,__
 __
 
• Ayodhya is a city situated on the banks of the holy river Saryu in **Uttar Pradesh.**
 
• Ayodhya is the birthplace of the Hindu deity Lord **Rama.**
 
• Ayodhya is also known as **Saket,** is an ancient city of India.
 
• Ayodhya was the capital of the **Kosala Kingdom** during ancient times.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hyderabad** is a city located on the banks of the **Musi River** in Telangana.
 
• **Jaipur** is the capital city of Rajasthan.
 
 
• It is also called "pink city".
 
 
 
• **Ahmedabad** is a city in Gujarat.
 
 
• Ahmedabad city is located on the banks of the **River Sabarmati.**
